svg.text: PG-1 wiring 10/10: Level lights + 330 ohm resistors -> PCF8574 board
Each light's 2 legs go to 2 P pins, either way round (red with signal? swap that light's 2 wires). P4-P7 each also get a 330 ohm to VCC,
soldered on the PCF board's UNDERSIDE; the 4 resistors' bottom legs are joined and go to a VCC pin.
Steps (the number is on the wire)
in light: the LEFT leg (either way round) -> PCF8574:
in light (swap its 2 legs, or set kSwapLightColours, if
in light: the RIGHT leg (either way round) ->
out light: the LEFT leg (either way round) ->
out light: the RIGHT leg (either way round) ->
330 ohm resistor 1: its TOP leg -> PCF8574: 'P4' on
330 ohm pull-up: solder its leg on the PCF board's
330 ohm resistor 2: its TOP leg -> PCF8574: 'P5' on
330 ohm resistor 3: its TOP leg -> PCF8574: 'P6' on
330 ohm resistor 4: its TOP leg -> PCF8574: 'P7' on
330 ohm resistor 1: its BOTTOM leg -> PCF8574: 'VCC'
the 4 resistors' other ends joined -> underside of a
330 ohm resistor 1: its BOTTOM leg -> 330 ohm
330 ohm resistor 2: its BOTTOM leg -> 330 ohm
330 ohm resistor 3: its BOTTOM leg -> 330 ohm
